test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the name of the scheme launched by Himachal Pradesh government for dairy farmers?
solution:
The correct answer is **Sanjeevani**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sanjeevani** is the name of the scheme launched by the Himachal Pradesh government.
 
• The scheme is aimed at supporting **dairy farmers** in the state.
 
• It provides various **benefits** and incentives to promote dairy farming.
 
• The initiative is part of the government's efforts to boost **agriculture and allied sectors**.
 
• It is designed to improve the **livelihood** of dairy farmers and increase milk production.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Scheme Component
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Financial Support
 Provides **subsidies** and loans to dairy farmers for purchasing cattle and setting up dairy units.
 
 

 Training Programs
 Offers **training** and workshops on advanced dairy farming techniques.
 
 

 Healthcare
 Ensures regular **veterinary services** and healthcare facilities for dairy animals.
 
 

 Infrastructure Development
 Focuses on building **infrastructure** such as milk collection centers and cold storage units.
 
 

 Market Linkages
 Creates better **market linkages** to help farmers get fair prices for their produce.
